design: Exploratory Random Forest + predicted class. Prior LR, interaction and Night results were known. Freeze this design before RF fitting; do not revise the model or endpoints after outer scoring.
population: Original four-weather 1600 adverse train images. Identical 17 outer leave-one-filename-group-out splits and three inner grouped folds. The original 406 validation images stay separate.
predictors: Raw MSP, normalized entropy, top-two margin, and 19 fixed one-hot indicators of the predicted trainId. Tree splits use original continuous units. No class-by-MSP product, meteorological condition, location, GT or correctness enters X.
selection: Same saved 512 uniformly drawn valid pixels per image (seed 805) and inverse inclusion weights, normalized to mean 1 within fit. scikit-learn 1.9.1 uses those weights for bootstrap sampling probabilities, not twice as split weights. Each tree takes half the partition size with replacement. Select depth by arithmetic mean of three weighted inner APs; ties within 1e-12 choose shallower. Refit on all 16 outer training groups. RF scores are mean leaf error fractions summed in stored tree order using float64.
primary: All identical valid pixels scored from frozen CUDA logits. Equal-group mean retrospective accepted error near 80% using the pre-existing 100000 arcsine-sqrt bins and nearest whole-bin policy. Compare all six methods; pair RF with frozen MSP, entropy, LR3, LR+Class and LR+Class×MSP.
secondary: Report AUROC, AP, right-step AURC, error prevalence, actual retrospective coverage, exact risk and coverage at each outer-training-derived weighted 80% score quantile, per-group/weather numbers and compute cost. Equal group weighting except explicitly marked pixel counts.
night: At 1/5/10/20% in each of three Night groups, retain observed whole-bin counts/coverage and expected error at the same pixel budget using equal-probability inclusion in the boundary bin. Main diagnostic is 10%. Check against unbinned shared seed-806 QA sample with label-independent tie keys. Record vegetation errors in the actual accepted sets and total expected errors summed over three group budgets.
fog: All six Fog groups at the original near-80% endpoint. Quantify paired gains vs raw MSP and both class-aware LR variants, including any worsened groups.
limits: Weather-specific findings are descriptive, based on filename-derived proxies; no pixel-IID inference, new backbone or segmentation accuracy claim. This bounded one-seed RF is one comparison.
